name: streamtogether
description: Ver videos sincronizados y chatea en tiempo real con amigos. React + Node.js + Socket.IO + Prisma

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:server && npm run test:unit:web
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix web run test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:flow && npm run test:resilience
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix web run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
